newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse firms in light trade, breweries rise.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse firms in light trade, breweries rise.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index firmed slightly on Monday in light trade, with breweries among the risers, the stock exchange's market report showed.
The Index rose 0.84 percent to 358.05 points from Friday's 357.21 points.
Just 86,700 shares changed hands compared to 542,330 in a flurry of trading on Friday. Offers outstripped bids by 2,478,000 to 665,000.

Risers were Accra Brewery Limited ABL.GH (+1 cedi to 594 cedis), Kumasi Brewery Limited (+1 to 686), Enterprise Insurance Company (+10 to 470) and agro-industrial and trading company Unilever (+25 TO 750).
Mobil Oil Ghana Limited (-100 to 5,000) was the sole faller.
